review: 702.145b-4: 702.145b's third ability (can't transform except through daybound) was not exercised; added a Moonmist scenario contrasting Hound Tamer with the non-daybound Gatstaf Shepherd.

scenarios.title: A front-face-up daybound permanent transforms the moment it becomes night
decisions: A casts Into the Night, tapping four Mountains.
Both players pass; Into the Night resolves: it becomes night, A discards no cards and draws one card.

variants.label: becomes_night
variants.expected: It is night. Hound Tamer transforms to its back face Untamed Pup (4/4 Werewolf with trample and nightbound) as Into the Night resolves, not through a state-based check.

variants.label: stays_day
variants.delta: A does not cast Into the Night and passes priority.
variants.expected: It stays day during this turn. Hound Tamer stays front face up as a 3/3 Human Werewolf with trample and daybound.

scenarios.forge_notes: The day/night state and the face of a transformed permanent are not fields of any record today; the harness reads them from the game state.

scenarios.title: A daybound permanent enters transformed while it is night
decisions: A casts Hound Tamer, tapping three Forests.
Both players pass; Hound Tamer resolves.

variants.label: night
variants.expected: Hound Tamer enters the battlefield transformed: it is Untamed Pup, a 4/4 Werewolf with trample. It is still night.

variants.label: day
variants.delta: It is day instead of night.
variants.expected: Hound Tamer enters front face up as a 3/3 Human Werewolf with trample. It is still day.

scenarios.title: Day becomes night when the active player casts no spells during their own turn
decisions: A casts no spell and passes priority through every step of A's turn.
B's turn begins; the untap step checks the spells A cast during A's turn.

variants.label: no_spell_cast
variants.expected: As B's turn begins it becomes night. Hound Tamer transforms to Untamed Pup (4/4 Werewolf with trample).

variants.label: spell_cast
variants.delta: In main phase 1 A casts Shock targeting B, tapping the Mountain, and it resolves.
variants.expected: B takes 2 damage (life 18). As B's turn begins it stays day. Hound Tamer stays front face up as a 3/3.

scenarios.title: When it is neither day nor night, controlling a daybound permanent makes it day

setup.notes: It is neither day nor night: nothing has set the time yet.

decisions: A casts Hound Tamer, tapping three Forests.
Both players pass; Hound Tamer resolves.

variants.label: neither
variants.expected: Hound Tamer enters front face up as a 3/3 and it becomes day.

variants.label: night
variants.delta: It is already night instead of neither day nor night.
variants.expected: It does not become day: it stays night and Hound Tamer enters transformed as Untamed Pup, a 4/4 Werewolf with trample.

scenarios.title: A back-face-up nightbound permanent transforms the moment it becomes day

setup.notes: It is night. Hound Tamer on A's battlefield is back face up (Untamed Pup, 4/4).

decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping a Mountain; it resolves.
A casts a second Shock targeting B, tapping the other Mountain; it resolves.
A passes the turn. B's turn begins; the untap step checks the spells A cast during A's turn.

variants.label: two_spells
variants.expected: B takes 4 damage (life 16). As B's turn begins it becomes day. Untamed Pup transforms to Hound Tamer (3/3 Human Werewolf with trample), immediately and not through a state-based check.

variants.label: one_spell
variants.delta: A casts only one Shock; the second Shock stays in hand.
variants.expected: B takes 2 damage (life 18). As B's turn begins it stays night. The permanent stays Untamed Pup, a 4/4 Werewolf with trample.

scenarios.forge_notes: The puzzle state needs a transformed permanent on the battlefield, which a harness can set up directly.

scenarios.title: With neither day nor night, a nightbound permanent and no daybound permanents makes it night

setup.notes: It is neither day nor night. Hound Tamer on A's battlefield is back face up (Untamed Pup, 4/4); no permanent with daybound is on the battlefield.

decisions: Both players pass priority; the game checks day and night.

variants.label: nightbound_present
variants.expected: It becomes night. Untamed Pup stays back face up as a 4/4 Werewolf with trample.

variants.label: no_nightbound
variants.delta: A's permanent is Grizzly Bears instead of Hound Tamer.
variants.expected: It stays neither day nor night. Grizzly Bears is a 2/2.

scenarios.forge_notes: A back-face-up nightbound permanent while it is neither day nor night is reachable only through effects that put a double-faced card onto the battlefield transformed before day or night has begun; the harness sets the state directly.

scenarios.title: A daybound permanent can't transform except through its daybound ability
decisions: A casts Moonmist, tapping two Forests.

variants.label: daybound
variants.expected: Moonmist resolves. Hound Tamer does not transform: it stays front face up as a 3/3 Human Werewolf with trample. It is still day.

variants.label: no_daybound
variants.delta: A's creature is Gatstaf Shepherd (a Human Werewolf double-faced card without daybound) instead of Hound Tamer.
variants.expected: Moonmist resolves and Gatstaf Shepherd transforms into Gatstaf Howler, a 3/3 Werewolf with intimidate.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the third daybound ability as a CantTransform static excepting the daybound cause. In the no_daybound variant nothing sets day or night, which does not affect the outcome.
